prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'Feedback Collector', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'LATAM', 'symptoms_observed': ['UI element not rendering', 'form fails to submit'], 'reported_business_impact': 'moderate', 'reported_affected_users': 33, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "Feedback form UI missing and submission failing for LATAM users", "description": "We are experiencing issues with the Feedback Collector tool in our production environment. Specifically, the main UI element for the feedback form is not rendering on the screen for users in the LATAM region. Because the form isn't loading, users are unable to submit any feedback. This has been happening for the past few hours and is affecting approximately 33 users who rely on this tool to report issues. Please investigate why the UI is missing and why the submission endpoint seems unresponsive."}]}
